SCTP::collect
Description
Causes SCTP to start collecting the specified amount of content data.
After collecting the data, event CLIENT_DATA will be triggered.
Syntax
SCTP
::
collect
[
<
length
>
]
SCTP::collect <length>
Causes SCTP to start collecting the specified amount of content data.
The parameter specifies the minimum number of bytes to collect.
SCTP::collect
When length is not specified, CLIENT_DATA will be triggered for every
received packet. To stop collecting data, use SCTP::release.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
SCTP
::
collect
15
}
when
CLIENT_DATA
{
if
{
[
SCTP
::
payload
15
]
contains
"XYZ"
}
{
pool
xyz_servers
}
else
{
pool
web_servers
}
SCTP
::
release
}
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.debug
"CLIENT_ACCEPTED"
SCTP
::
collect
}
when
CLIENT_DATA
{
set
tcplen
[
SCTP
::
payload
length
]
log
local0.debug
"CLIENT_DATA ($tcplen)"
#Assume that you need at least 20 bytes of data for some purpose
if
{
$tcplen
>=
20
}
{
log
local0.debug
"Collected at least 20 bytes. releasing"
#Release collected data
SCTP
::
release
# Collect new data - CLIENT_DATA will be called again
SCTP
::
collect
}
}
